info.title: Learning Core API
info.description: Headless multi-tenant learning API: structured course content, recomputed progress, server-side scoring with partial credit, publicly verifiable credentials, and metered usage. Content is typed JSON blocks, never markup.

post.summary: Create a learner. external_ref is your own stable user id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stripe-semantics idempotency: replays return the stored response byte-identical with Idempotent-Replay: true; reuse with a different request is a 422; in-flight is a 409. Retained 24h.

get.summary: Recomputed progress across all of a learner's enrollments.

post.summary: Create a course, optionally with modules.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stripe-semantics idempotency: replays return the stored response byte-identical with Idempotent-Replay: true; reuse with a different request is a 422; in-flight is a 409. Retained 24h.

get.summary: Fetch a course with its modules and lesson metadata (not bodies).

post.summary: Add a lesson (typed blocks + citations) to a course.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stripe-semantics idempotency: replays return the stored response byte-identical with Idempotent-Replay: true; reuse with a different request is a 422; in-flight is a 409. Retained 24h.

blocks.description: Typed content blocks (prose, list, table, trap). Never markup.

get.summary: Fetch a lesson: typed content blocks and citation rows. Never markup.

post.summary: Create an assessment with its items. Answer keys are stored server-side and never returned.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.summary: Fetch an assessment and its items — prompts and options only, never answer keys.
Answer keys for every item of an assessment (admin scope only). For a consumer that grades constructed items server-side and posts points through /v1/attempts/{id}/grade. Never expose to a learner.

post.summary: Enrol a learner in a course.

get.summary: Fetch an enrollment with recomputed progress. The server computes; the client never asserts.

post.summary: Record a lesson completion; returns recomputed course progress.

Your own metered usage by day. A customer who cannot audit their bill will not renew.

get.summary: Citations whose verified_on is older than `days` (default 180) or missing, with their lesson and course.

get.summary: List approvals, optionally filtered by subject and approver role. Newest first within a subject is up to the caller; order is by creation.
Public credential verification. No API key. Exact-match only; strictly rate limited per IP.

apiKey.description: Tenant API key, e.g. reli_xJ9w… Scopes: read, write, admin.
